name: messages-bridge
description: Teach Codex to use the separately installed Messages Bridge app and its bounded local MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Messages Bridge connects Codex to a separately permissioned macOS menu-bar app. It provides persistent read access to direct and group conversations plus bounded attachments, and text sending governed by an Off, Ask Before Sending, or Send Automatically mode. Editing, deletion, arbitrary SQL, and arbitrary file access remain unavailable.
capabilities: List and read Apple Messages group chats
Send policy-controlled direct and group text messages
interface.defaultPrompt: Read or send a direct or group Apple Messages conversation through Messages Bridge. Keep reads narrow, send only when explicitly requested, and do not access the database directly.
